prompt.text:
Implement a class `RegistrationValidator` with a static method `validate(value)`. It returns an array of error objects in the fixed field order `handle`, `contact`, `passphrase`; each error has exactly `{ field, code }`. `value` must be a non-null, non-array object, otherwise return `[{ field: 'payload', code: 'invalid' }]`. A valid handle is a string whose trimmed length is 1 through 18. A valid contact is a string with exactly one `@`, at least one character on each side, and at least one `.` after the `@` that is neither the first nor last domain character. A valid passphrase is a string of at least 10 characters containing an ASCII uppercase letter and an ASCII digit. Emit at most one error per field, using codes `invalid_handle`, `invalid_contact`, and `invalid_passphrase`. Ignore extra properties and do not mutate the input. Export exactly `{ RegistrationValidator }` using `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
